findings.title: Scanned 44 source files for credential leaks
findings.details: No active production secrets or hardcoded admin pins (BABAL2026) detected.

findings.title: Zero-Leak OTP Enforcement Verified
findings.details: Admin panel does not render OTP in UI descriptions or notification templates.

findings.title: Audit Log Zero-Leak Compliance
findings.details: Audit logs conceal dynamic OTP numbers and hashes from logs.

findings.title: Zero Unsafe DOM Injections
findings.details: React JSX Virtual DOM auto-escapes all user text; no raw eval() or unescaped innerHTML found.

findings.title: 5/5 Hardened Defense Headers Active
findings.details: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are enforced.

findings.title: Creator Main Block & Customer Child Block Hierarchy Validated
findings.details: Shop creators serve as anchor blocks with chained customer child transactions and encrypted carrier OTP hashes.

findings.title: RFC 9116 security.txt Active
findings.details: Standardized security contact and safe harbor policy exposed at /.well-known/security.txt.
